Explore new and used car deals with Carwow: https://bit.ly/Change-Your-Car-081026

It’s time for an incredible Porsche head-to-head! 

We’ve got our hands on the all-new Porsche Cayenne Turbo, and it’s lining up against the all-new Porsche 911 Turbo S! 

We all know by now that the 911 Turbo S rolls up with hybrid power, but the all-new Cayenne is 100% electric! But does this huge SUV have what it takes to bring down this incredible sports car? Let’s take a closer look at the stats… 

Starting with the 911 Turbo S, it’s powered by a 3.6-litre twin-turbo flat-six hybrid, and it puts down 711hp and 800Nm. This power is sent to all four wheels, and it weighs in at 1,740kg.

Then we come to the Cayenne Turbo. It’s powered by two electric motors, and these combine to produce an incredible 1,156hp and 1,500Nm! It may be heavy, tipping the scales at 2,645kg, but it still launches like a rocket ship!
